title: Harden recovery and policy invariants
objective: Add substantial deterministic integration coverage for reconstruction, pause, policy history, retries, and duplicate event delivery; fix only directly exposed substrate defects.
scope: deterministic recovery and policy integration tests
minimal directly necessary corrections to the local V0.1 substrate

may: modify directly relevant local supervisor modules
modify package test/check scripts if required
may_not: deploy, merge, push, or create a PR

relevant_context: .opsle/specification.md DS-008, DS-009, DS-024, DS-035, DS-051, DS-052, DS-055, DS-060, DS-063, DS-068
Current policy is Codex enabled, Claude disabled, review off
No live provider invocation belongs in deterministic tests
expected_deliverable: A meaningful recovery/policy test suite plus the narrowest necessary substrate fixes.
expected_evidence: tests reconstruct state using repo files only
pause survives a fresh CLI process
policy can transition to Claude enabled and risk_based review in a fixture without a provider call
prior attempt policy snapshot remains unchanged
retry creates a new attempt and does not overwrite the first
actual changed files remain within authorization
acceptance_criteria: new tests cover disk-only reconstruction and simulated process loss
new tests cover pause persistence and runtime policy changes
new tests prove historical policy snapshot immutability
new tests prove retries create distinct attempts
new tests prove duplicate event handling is idempotent
no test invokes a live AI provider
prohibited_actions: launching an AI child from the test suite
operator_policy_constraints: Codex is the only enabled provider
